title: Zogre Flesh Eaters
start: Talk to Grish, located west of Gu'Tanoth and south of Castle Wars.

recommended.t: 40 Prayer for Protect from Ranged, preferably level 43 for Protect from Melee
20 Crafting for a better chance on making the correct portrait, the higher your crafting the better your chances.
8 Herblore for creation of Relicym's balm to unlock Uglug Nar's store
A comp ogre bow (or can be learned how to create during the quest)
Activated Yanille lodestone, ring of duelling with at least 4 charges, dramen/lunar staff for fairy ring access (if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift hasn't been completed).
If killing Slash Bash with ranged, comp ogre bow and at least 50 mithril brutal arrows (or better)

rewards.t: Ability to fletch composite ogre bow and brutal arrows
Take the black prism to either Zavistic Rarve for 2,000 coins or to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village for 5,000 coins.
Take a 2, 3 or 4 dose relicym's balm potion to Uglug Nar for 300, 650 or 1,000 coins respectively. Doing so will unlock his shop.

steps.t: Talk to Grish in Jiggig, located a short run south of the Castle Wars. [Chat: 3 What are Zogres? › 4 Can I help in any way? › Accept]
Talk to the ogre guard (without the combat level, east).
Climb over the crushed barricade.
Run east and down the stairs.
Run as far north-west as you can, and search the skeleton, kill the zombie, and take his ruined backpack.

sub.t: If you're in combat when trying to search the skeleton, the zombie will not spawn.

steps.t: Open the ruined backpack. You will get a dragon inn tankard, a knife, and rotten food. Drop all except the dragon inn tankard.
Search the broken lectern behind the skeleton.
Read the torn page.
Search the nearby ogre coffin until you find a black prism.
Enter the Dragon Inn pub in Yanille.
Use the dragon inn tankard on the bartender.
Talk to Zavistic Rarve on the floor 2 of the Wizards' Guild. Ring the bell outside if you lack the requirements. [Chat: 1 What did you say I should do?]
Enter the house just north of the guild, floor 2, talk to Sithik in bed. [Chat: 3 Do you mind if I look around?]
Search the drawers, the cupboard, and the wardrobe.
Read the 3 books, use the papyrus on Sithik to make a portrait, then use the portrait on Sithik.
Make sure that Sithik says that he appreciates "honesty" of the portrait or you will have to make another. If he says 'truth' you will have to try again. There is more papyrus in the drawers.
Use the portrait on the bartender. He will return it as a Signed portrait.

sub.t: If he just says that he recognises Sithik without signing the portrait, it means that you forgot to show him the dragon inn tankard.

steps.t: Talk to Zavistic Rarve. He will give you a strange potion. [Chat: 1 I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres. › 3 I have some items that I'd like you to look at.]

sub.t: You must have the three books, signed portrait, dragon inn tankard, torn page and black prism with you otherwise he will say you do not have enough evidence

p: The Bartender confirming Sithik as the culprit

steps.t: Use the strange potion on the cup of tea beside Sithik.

Climb down the ladder, climb up the ladder, ask Sithik all the possible questions. [Chat: 1 How do I remove the effects of the spell from the area? › 2 How do I get rid of the undead ogres? › 3 How do I get rid of the disease? › 4 Sorry, I have to go.]
Return to Grish at the quest start, he will give you a key. [Chat: 1 I found who's responsible for the Zogres being here.]
Talk to him again to be able to create a comp ogre bow and brutal arrows, which can be used to fight the upcoming boss. [Chat: 2 There must be an easier way to kill these zogres!]

sub.t: (Optional) Use a clean rogue's purse on a vial of water, and then add a clean snakeweed to create a relicym's balm. Use this on Uglug Nar next to Grish, and you unlock his shop Uglug's Stuffsies which sells the comp ogre bow. This will also complete the Brutal Stuffsies achievement.

(Optional) Either buy brutal arrows from the Grand Exchange, or fletch them at this point; there are achey trees to the west of Grish, chop them down and fletch their logs into shafts, then attach feathers, and tip them with nails of your choosing.

steps.t: Cross the barricade to the east and go down the stairs again.
Once inside, run directly west, through the double doors and down more stairs.
Go north-east and search the stand in front of the pile of skulls. Prepare for battle.
Kill Slash Bash, pick up the Ogre artefact he drops.
p: Slash Bash is easily attacked behind this safe spot

steps.t: Return to Grish at quest start. [Chat: 1 Yeah, I have them here!]
Quest complete!

p: The skeleton leaning against the lectern
